description: Secretariat of Judicial Service Commission - Amendment to the Gaz. No. 14 of 08.12.1998 replacing the qualifications referred to under appointments, promotions & transfers of Judicial officers of the Judicial Service Commission.
reasoning: This gazette notification from the Judicial Service Commission outlines eligibility qualifications for judicial officer positions (Magistrate and President of Labour Tribunal). It deals specifically with court appointments and judicial service matters, falling clearly under the Judicial/Law Enforcement category (Type 9) as it involves judicial officer qualifications and appointments within the court system.
